result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there is a visible data bug ('€NaN delivery') in the Fastest near you section and a horizontal clipping issue on the third restaurant card. A few minor cosmetic refinements are also noted.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a failed numeric parse or missing delivery-fee value being rendered raw.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees and format the value safely (e.g., show 'Free delivery' or a proper € amount); never render NaN to the UI.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peek/scroll affordance (e.g., partial card with scroll hint) so horizontal scrolling is clearly intentional.

issues.description: The notification bell in the top-right has only a small red dot indicator with no visible label or badge count, which may be unclear to screen-reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g., 'Notifications, 1 new') and consider a count badge or text alternative for the dot indicator.

issues.description: Category filter chips ('Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) are cut off at the right edge with no visible scroll cue, similar to the restaurant row.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade or padding to signal that the chip row is horizontally scrollable.
